Existing health above cap is not directly damaged; remaining permitted heal is zero. Client FreezeHeartsEffect separately tests local player and SHOW_FROZEN_HEALTH, uses same fraction/factor rounding, counts heartIndex only for CONTAINER and resets at render tick START.
